verdict.rationale: The cubic CLI reviews local changes before you push, finds bugs, and generates a fix prompt for your coding agent (cubic-docs-7, cubic-docs-70). cubic also installs into Cursor, VS Code, Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI via its IDE/agent setup, skills and MCP server (cubic-docs-35, cubic-docs-17, cubic-docs-72), and the docs index confirms review runs 'in local coding workflows' (cubic-probe-1). The local review apparently depends on a connected Codex/Claude Code model for better results (cubic-docs-71), so it is not shown to be identical to the PR review. Missing for 10: evidence that the local review matches the PR review (same rules, custom agents, models), native inline in-editor findings rather than CLI/agent-driven output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
